description: A professional Oracle Database learning roadmap progressing from foundational concepts to database administration, engineering, troubleshooting and architecture.

modules.title: Oracle Database Fundamentals
modules.description: Understand relational database concepts, Oracle Database capabilities, versions, editions and core terminology.

objectives.title: Understand database and relational database concepts
objectives.description: Explain databases, relational models, tables, rows, columns, keys, relationships and constraints.

objectives.title: Understand SQL and database interaction
objectives.description: Explain how SQL is used to define, manipulate, query and control relational database data.

objectives.title: Understand Oracle Database capabilities and architecture at a high level
objectives.description: Identify major Oracle Database capabilities, common deployment models and the distinction between database and instance.

objectives.title: Understand Oracle versions, releases and support terminology
objectives.description: Recognize Oracle release numbering, release updates, editions and the importance of support and patch lifecycle.

modules.title: Oracle Database Architecture
modules.description: Study the physical and logical architecture, memory structures, processes and storage organization.

objectives.title: Differentiate Oracle Database and Oracle Instance
objectives.description: Explain the distinction between persistent database files and the memory and processes that form an Oracle instance.

objectives.title: Identify Oracle physical database files
objectives.description: Explain the purpose of datafiles, control files, online redo log files, archived redo logs and parameter files.

objectives.title: Understand the System Global Area
objectives.description: Explain the SGA and its major components, including the buffer cache, shared pool, redo log buffer and other memory areas.

objectives.title: Understand the Program Global Area
objectives.description: Explain PGA memory, private SQL areas, work areas and the relationship between PGA and server processes.

modules.title: Oracle Instance and Background Processes
modules.description: Understand instance startup, shutdown, server processes and essential Oracle background processes.

objectives.title: Understand Oracle instance startup stages
objectives.description: Explain NOMOUNT, MOUNT and OPEN stages, the files read at each stage and common startup failures.

objectives.title: Understand Oracle shutdown modes
objectives.description: Compare NORMAL, TRANSACTIONAL, IMMEDIATE and ABORT shutdown behavior and their operational implications.

objectives.title: Understand essential Oracle background processes
objectives.description: Explain the roles and interactions of DBWn, LGWR, CKPT, SMON, PMON, ARCn and other important background processes.

objectives.title: Observe Oracle processes using database views and operating-system tools
objectives.description: Identify Oracle processes through relevant dynamic performance views and operating-system process inspection.
